environment: macOS-26.5.2-arm64-arm-64bit-Mach-O; real SQLite databases and injected DirectFileSystem; four SIGKILL child publication cuts; ordinary serial integration targets; debug assertions enabled; isolated checkout target; debuginfo=0
limitations: MR-05 physical LTX verification, immutable image publication, retention and read-only SQLite qualification only. The crash-cut parent uses a plain-file fixture marker, not the Raft Engine apply marker: engine/image atomicity and command receipts remain MR-06 work. The query opener does not establish committed/query-serving authority. Capture and command/SDK integration, real group snapshot transfer, S3 archival/restore, physical power-loss, production infrastructure and performance/capacity qualification remain pending. The ignored child entry point is invoked and killed by its parent. No end-to-end serving or deployment claim is made.

additional_check_results.decoder: Both upstream LTX writer representations and optional database checksums; complete physical index/snapshot coverage, exact compressed lengths and bounded scratch/decoded allocations. Every truncation and bit mutation of representative files is refused without unwinding.
additional_check_results.apply: Real SQLite images cover exact base/result SHA-256, TXID gaps, declared byte/page bounds, page growth, truncation, multi-file updates and checksum enable/disable transitions. Valid file CRC with altered data still fails database CRC or mandatory result SHA-256.
additional_check_results.publication: Image fsync precedes exclusive final-name reservation, rename and directory fsync. Injected image/directory sync failures leave the old marker selected. Unexpected names are not overwritten; ambiguous final-name creation quarantines admission and preserves inventory.
additional_check_results.process_faults: Real SIGKILL cuts before image sync, after rename, after directory sync and after fixture-marker sync recover the image selected by the retained marker. An orphan/newest image is never chosen implicitly.
additional_check_results.queries: Actual SQL pins unchanged generations while newer ones are built; DDL/DML/temp/ATTACH/transaction/mutating PRAGMA operations are refused. Reads and read failures use injected file handles. Concurrent connections retain independent host clocks and keep the directory lock until the last reader closes.
additional_check_results.reclamation: Generation/disk admission refuses excess work; reader and durable retention roots prevent deletion. Recovery preserves unverified files pending authoritative marker selection. Deletion sync precedes capacity refund.
additional_check_results.regressions: 46 passed across native_raft_contract (6), native_raft_runtime (14), native_raft_storage (10), native_raft_transport (9), native_replication (6) and native_storage (1). Three ignored child helpers are invoked by their parent cases.
additional_check_results.checks: Cellar and LTX libraries plus native_raft_ltx pass Clippy with warnings denied; LTX core and all-feature checks pass. Existing vendored Raft warnings remain visible in the raw logs. Formatting, module layout, native dependency policy, documentation and all 17 planning-tool tests pass.
